title: VEED Alternative for Fast Burned-In Captions
metaDescription: A single-purpose VEED alternative: upload, review the captions, export an MP4 with them burned in. Free exports have no watermark.
h1: A VEED alternative for fast, burned-in captions
intro: Supertitle is a single-purpose tool: upload a video, review the automatic captions, pick a style and download the MP4. There's nothing else on the screen, and exports on the free plan carry no watermark.
summary: Single-purpose and fast, with no watermark on free exports.
verdict: Pick Supertitle if burned-in captions are what you came for and you want to get from upload to MP4 quickly, without a watermark on the free plan. Stay with VEED if you need a complete online video editor, or captions as separate subtitle files.

comparisonTable.freeTierLimits: 720p exports and a small monthly auto-subtitle allowance
comparisonTable.limitsCountedBy: AI credits per seat; subtitles unlimited up to 50 hours a month (fair use)
comparisonTable.platform: Browser, plus Android and iOS apps
comparisonTable.editingModel: Subtitle text list, with timing on a timeline

whereTheyWin: Full online editor: VEED covers cutting, text, music, recording and more in one place. Supertitle only does captions.
Subtitle files: VEED can give you captions as separate subtitle files. Supertitle exports an MP4 with the captions burned in, not SRT or VTT files.

switchingSteps.title: Upload once
switchingSteps.text: Drop the video in. The transcript is ready, word by word, in the language spoken.

switchingSteps.title: Review, don't rebuild
switchingSteps.text: Read through the text and fix what's off. Splitting, merging and timing happen right in the document.

switchingSteps.title: Download the MP4
switchingSteps.text: Pick one of five styles, adjust it if you like, and export. No watermark, on any plan.

faq.question: How fast is it?
faq.answer: Transcription starts as soon as the upload finishes, and you edit the text right after. For a short video, the whole job usually fits in a few minutes.

faq.question: Can I download an SRT file?
faq.answer: No. Supertitle exports MP4 files with the captions burned in. To convert subtitle files you already have, use the free SRT to VTT and VTT to SRT converters.

faq.question: Is there a watermark on free exports?
faq.answer: No. No plan adds a watermark, the free plan included.

faq.question: What resolution are exports?

cta.heading: From upload to MP4 in minutes
cta.text: Caption your next video on the free plan. No watermark, no card.
